zh: 新增局域网同步能力，并补充启动方式与偏好设置。
搜索能力增强，支持按附件、定位、双链和时间筛选，WebDAV 体验与坚果云兼容性同步优化。
修复列表工具栏插入异常，并继续优化附件上传、桌面端退出行为与实验室布局。
en: Added LAN sync support plus new startup-mode and preference options.
Search is now stronger with filters for attachments, location, backlinks, and time, while WebDAV flows and Nutstore compatibility were also improved.
Fixed toolbar insertion issues in lists and kept polishing attachment uploads, desktop exit behavior, and the lab layout.

zh: 搜索支持附件、定位、双链、时间筛选
新增启动方式与偏好设置
en: Search now supports filtering by attachments, location, backlinks, and time.
Added startup mode and preference options.

zh: 优化 WebDAV 界面与同步逻辑
优化附件上传逻辑与附件分类
优化桌面端退出程序体验
en: Improved the WebDAV UI and sync flow.
Optimized attachment upload logic and attachment categorization.

zh: 修复无序列表、有序列表、待办事项工具栏无法正常插入的问题
en: Fixed the toolbar insertion issue for unordered lists, ordered lists, and todo items.
